verdict.rationale: Gecko documents a 'Fail-on severity' threshold that controls whether its pass/fail PR check fails, so lower-severity findings need not block merges. It also separates PR-introduced findings from pre-existing ones. Findings carry a confidence score, but nothing documents gating or filtering on confidence, and a hands-on report of 100%-confidence false positives makes that score a weak noise filter. missing for 10: gating or threshold on confidence score, documented severity/confidence filtering of findings in the UI or API, CI build-gate usage beyond PR checks, independent corroboration of the severity gate.

support.subject: As a developer, I can filter and gate on findings by severity or confidence so low-value noise does not block builds

citations.quote: **Fail-on severity**: the severity threshold that fails the check (for example, fail on High and above).
Gecko posts a pass/fail check back to GitHub or GitLab so reviewers see the security status inline.
Findings introduced by the PR are separated from pre-existing ones, so reviewers focus on what the change adds.
Each finding includes a severity (CVSS 4.0), a confidence score
